Sergi,

I created test (CacheIndexStreamerTest) reproducing this issue. Looks like there is no issues on cache side, but something goes wrong in offheap indexing. Could you please take a look.

Thanks

Semyon,

I've ran the test in 1.4 with tracing and got the results below. They basically mean that value was not unswapped into indexing when the key was removed.
To fix this behavior we have two options: either method IgniteH2Indexing.onUnswap must be called before remove
or cache value must be provided in IgniteH2Indexing.remove (it is null right now).
